title: 第十五章 血炼将起第十六章 诸宗汇聚
lines: 战后烟尘弥漫于此方天地之间，雷涅双眼微眯的望着迷雾中那盛槐被自己攻势轰击而飞的方向。
其能清晰的感觉到那里除了自己攻势的残余波动外，已是没了丝毫的其余气息。
这倒不是说，那盛槐被自己轰杀成渣，消散于无形中。
反倒是有极大的可能，其在见识过雷涅此番诡异实力后，自知接下来已再无与雷涅抗衡的手段，果断遁逃而走了。
当然即便从逻辑上讲，后一种推论，是最趋近于现实的真相。
但真要说，凭借先前那种骇人攻势，将这区区处于普通真丹层次的盛槐轰杀成渣，雷涅心里对于此一说法，还真有几分信服之意。
莫要说旁人在面对先前那等攻势时，会被骇的亡魂皆冒。
就算让雷涅自己应对先前自己发出的那道攻势时，恐怕唯有遁逃，避之，才是雷涅能做出的唯一选择。
若是硬撼而上的话，最终肯定会落得个，跟那盛槐一样的下场，甚至说不定还不如那盛槐！
至少其尚能博出一线生机，捡回一条性命。要是换成雷涅……足有九成的概率，雷涅会当场陨落！
“没想到，将体内全部神念灌注进法决中，竟会让法决的威力，被催发至此等地步！”
雷涅心下再为自己竟能催动出此种威力的攻势，而感到心惊肉跳，并暗自惊叹的同时。
不由的将心神又是放到了体内的神念上，此番若是没有这远超普通真丹修士的雄浑神念，最后的胜负成败还真是两说之事。
想到此点，雷涅身侧的手掌不由自主的伸向了，悬挂于腰间的储物袋。手指轻碰间，徐徐磨砂着储物袋粗糙的外表，一缕神念随着雷涅手指磨砂间，涌入其内，感应着第二躯体正安静的悬浮其内。
雷涅嘴角不经扯出一抹莫名弧度，眼中有着难掩的兴奋之色，不断的流溢而出。
仅仅只是炼化了那么一小股的黑色神念，便能让自己在对敌时，拥有这番可以扭转战局的强悍底牌。
若是真到了哪一天，能将第二躯体内的黑色神念全部炼化，为己所用……
就算没法与灭境抗衡，想来灭境之下的存在，将在无人能对雷涅造成丝毫威胁。
此等自信并非只凭，这单单一次与同阶修士的争斗而突然产生的，而是在通过此番比拼之后，雷涅终是彻底确定了自己的实力到达了何种地步。
现在的雷涅可以说是，只要不遇见化丹境以上的修士，都有着轻松与之抗衡的实力。
而这还只是那么一缕被炼化的黑色神念所带来的，所以当黑色神念万全被炼化后，雷涅又有什么理由不相信，其能带给自己的必然是常人难以企及的造化功果！
“真是期待啊！那一天的到来！”
雷涅仰头轻叹一声，望着夜色下泛起的星斗晨光，眼中于此时，与其辉映出一抹怅然，以及对自身踏入的这番天地大道，产生出恒古不灭的无穷神往之意！
content_en:
After the war, the smoke and dust filled the space here. Rene narrowed his eyes and looked at the direction in the mist where the Sophora japonica was bombarded by his offensive.
He could clearly feel that except for the residual fluctuations of his own offensive, there was no other breath at all.
This does not mean that Sheng Huai was killed by himself and dissipated into nothingness.
On the contrary, there is a great possibility that after seeing Reine's strange strength, he knew that he would no longer have the means to compete with Reine, and fled decisively.
Of course, even logically speaking, the latter inference is the truth closest to reality.
But if you really want to say that with the terrifying offensive before, Sheng Huai, who was only at the ordinary true elixir level, was beaten to ashes, Reine was somewhat convinced by this statement in his heart.
Not to mention that others would be frightened to death when facing the previous offensive.
Even if Rene was left to deal with the previous offensive, running away and avoiding it would be the only choice Rene could make.
If you try to fight back, you will definitely end up with the same fate as Sheng Huai, or maybe even worse than that Sheng Huai!
At least it can still gain a glimmer of hope and save a life. If it were Reine... there was a 90% chance that Reine would die on the spot!
"I didn't expect that pouring all the spiritual thoughts in the body into the magic weapon would actually increase the power of the magic weapon to such an extent!"
Rene felt frightened that he could actually activate such a powerful offensive, and was secretly amazed at the same time.
He couldn't help but focus on the spiritual thoughts in his body again. Without this powerful spiritual thoughts that far exceeded those of ordinary Zhendan cultivators, the final victory or defeat would have been a matter of two opinions.
Thinking of this, Rene's hand on his side involuntarily reached for the storage bag hanging on his waist. As the fingers touched lightly, the rough surface of the storage bag was slowly polished. A ray of spiritual thought flowed into it as Rene's fingers polished it, sensing that the second body was quietly suspended inside it.
The corner of Rene's mouth curled up in an inexplicable way, and there was unconcealable excitement in his eyes, constantly overflowing.
Just by refining such a small amount of black divine thought, you can have a powerful trump card that can turn the tide of the battle when facing the enemy.
If one day comes, I can refine all the black divine thoughts in the second body and use them for my own use...
Even if there is no way to compete with the realm of annihilation, no one will be able to pose the slightest threat to Rene after thinking about the existence under the realm of annihilation.
This kind of self-confidence did not arise suddenly from just a single battle with a monk of the same level, but after this competition, Rene finally determined how far his strength had reached.
It can be said that Reine now has the strength to easily compete with monks who are not at the Alchemy Realm or above.
And this is only brought about by a wisp of refined black divine thoughts, so when the black divine thoughts are completely refined, why does Reine have no reason not to believe that what it can bring to him must be a result of creation that is difficult for ordinary people to achieve!
"I'm really looking forward to it! That day will come!"
Reine raised his head and sighed softly, looking at the stars in the morning light under the night sky. At this moment, his eyes reflected a touch of despair, and he felt an eternal and endless yearning for the great avenue of heaven and earth he had entered!
